external_tests.title: Resume Uncompleted Treatment Alert
external_tests.full: TITLE: Resume Uncompleted Treatment Alert STATEMENT: >>> This test case verifies that the application alerts the operator if the loaded plan was not completely delivered and enables the operator to choose to deliver the remaining plan. <<< PREREQUISITES: >>> Load a plan for treatment in the Heracles Internal unit. <<< STEPS: >>> 1. Log in to the External application. 2. Navigate to the treatment view. 3. Press the Prepare button to prepare the treatment. 4. Press the Beam-On button to trigger emission delivery. 5. external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Record partial treatment STATEMENT: >>> The application shall record any partial treatments in a resolution of 0.01 minutes (600 msec) and mark this treatment field as partial in the DB. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Initialize the System
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Initialize the System STATEMENT: >>> The application shall implement functionality to initialize the firmware, instructing it to transition out of the startup state and into the cold state. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Filament Conditioning
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Filament Conditioning STATEMENT: >>> The application shall implement functionality to request filament conditioning from the firmware by specifying the target filament current. The application shall ensure that the target current is within valid operational limits before sending the request to the firmware. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Perform System Warmup in COLD State
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Perform System Warmup in COLD State STATEMENT: >>> The application shall implement functionality to request the firmware to perform a warmup procedure, which can only be initiated when the system is in the "COLD" state. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Treatment Plan Staging
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Treatment Plan Staging STATEMENT: >>> The application shall implement functionality to initiate a new treatment staging by sending a request to the firmware while the system is in the "PRIMED" state. This request shall include the operational point for the treatment plan. The response to the request shall consist of a session ID. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Load a Treatment Plan
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Load a Treatment Plan STATEMENT: >>> The application shall implement functionality to load a treatment plan into the firmware. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Treatment Plan Confirmation
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Treatment Plan Confirmation STATEMENT: >>> The application shall receive confirmation responses from the firmware for each operational point in the treatment plan. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Confirmation of Treatment Plan
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Confirmation of Treatment Plan STATEMENT: >>> The application shall confirm the operational point parameters of the treatment plan only after the staging process has been successfully completed. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Radiation Emission Control - Prepare process
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Radiation Emission Control - Prepare process STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an interface allowing the user to prepare the system for radiation emission. The preparation will include system warm-up and high voltage ramp-up. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Enable window switching after emission delivery.
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Enable window switching after emission delivery. STATEMENT: >>> The application shall enable the left tab bar when the emission is completed, and the plan is unloaded. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Daily Warmup - Progress Monitoring
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Quality Assurance - Daily Warmup - Progress Monitoring STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an interface that allows the user to monitor the progress of the warm-up process. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-53.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Daily Warmup - Log Performed Warmup
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Daily Warmup - Log Performed Warmup STATEMENT: >>> The application shall log all (Full and Fast) warmups performed during the system's lifetime. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Resume Beam On Process After Error Is Cleared
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Resume Beam On Process After Error Is Cleared STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have an interface allowing the user to resume an emission after a fault or interlock is cleared. When the resume process is triggered, the emission should continue for the remaining duration. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Resume Prepare process after the error is cleared
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Resume Prepare process after the error is cleared STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a control allowing the user to resume emission preparation after preparation interruption during warmup or high-voltage ramp-up. The operator will retrigger the Prepare process after clearing the fault or interlock. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Audit user's actions
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Audit user's actions STATEMENT: >>> The application shall audit in the system log when the user triggers an action such as: 1. Triggering treatment preparation. 2. Triggering emission delivery. 3. Triggering stop emission <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Enable Loading a Treatment Plan
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Enable Loading a Treatment Plan STATEMENT: >>> The application shall enable treatment plan loading only during staging periods. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Emission Progress Indicators
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Emission Progress Indicators STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an interface allowing the operator to monitor the progress of an emission delivery. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Reset Timers and Unload Plan after Treatment is Completed
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Reset Timers and Unload Plan after Treatment is Completed STATEMENT: >>> The application shall clear timers and unload a plan from the board and the UI when the treatment is finished. The application will prompt the user with a pop-up message when the treatment is finished, and the emission is delivered successfully. The info message will include an OK control, triggering a timer reset and unloading the plan. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Load For Treatment - Resume Uncompleted Treatment Alert
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Load For Treatment - Resume Uncompleted Treatment Alert STATEMENT: >>> The application shall alert the operator if the loaded plan was not completely delivered and enable the operator to choose to deliver the remaining plan (i.e., resume the treatment) or deliver the whole treatment plan. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Load For Treatment - Resume Uncompleted Treatment
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Load For Treatment - Resume Uncompleted Treatment STATEMENT: >>> The application shall enable the operator to resume uncompleted treatment. In case the last treatment was stopped in the middle and the delivery of the treatment plan was not completed, the operator should be able to resume the delivery of the remaining treatment. When a plan is loaded, the application should query the latest treatment and check if this treatment is marked as completed. If not, it will pop up a message to the user about the uncompleted treatment. If the user chooses to resume the treatment, the application should calculate the remaining time and use this as the plan to be delivered. If the user chooses not to resume, the plan should be loaded as is, and the whole treatment should be delivered. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Prevent user from starting an emission due to delta between magnetometers
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Prevent user from starting an emission due to delta between magnetometers STATEMENT: >>> The application shall prevent the user from starting an emission if the delta between the Front Magnetometer and Back Magnetometer correction values is larger than maxMagnetomerDiff. The Front Magnetometer and Back Magnetometer Correction Matrix values will be fetched from the DB. The MaxMagnetomerDiff should be defined in the machine's HeadConfiguration. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Allow Quality Checks with Dedicated Collimator only
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Quality Assurance - Allow Quality Checks with Dedicated Collimator only STATEMENT: >>> The application shall automatically identify that the dedicated QC collimator is connected. It should allow the operator to perform Quality Checks only if this is the connected collimator. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Physics View
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Quality Assurance - Physics View STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an interface that enables an authorized user to initiate an emission procedure to measure the quality of the beam. The user shall be able to select the Applicator type that is used and to set the beam parameters: Energy, Duration. Once an applicator and Energy are set, the Coils (X, Y, and Focus) and Heater Current that are configured for this Applicator will be populated to the UI. The application should alert the user if the connected applicator is different from the selected one. The emission process shall include the emission actions: Prepare, Beam-On, and Stop. All safety interlocks shall be cleared before emission. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-280.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: On-Screen Keyboard Adjustable Position
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: On-Screen Keyboard Adjustable Position STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide the user with the ability to reposition the On-Screen Keyboard on the screen so that it does not block critical interface components. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Telemetry
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Telemetry STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an interface that displays immutable semantic telemetry received from the control-board firmware in real time, including: * Control-board state and firmware mode * Emission and backup timers * Emission current and energy * Safety interlock states, the current required-interlock set, and system-fault categories The application shall select the telemetry layout from the reported firmware version and mode. A field that is not supplied by that firmware mode shall be shown as unavailable rather than as a false or zero measurement. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Stop Emission
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Stop Emission STATEMENT: >>> The treatment console shall include a stop control that allows the user to immediately terminate radiation emissions. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-3.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Emission visible indicator
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Emission visible indicator STATEMENT: >>> The treatment console shall provide a visible indicator for the entire time the X-rays are produced. The visual indication of X-ray emission will be provided by a glowing radiation icon Amber color. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Treatment Plan Execution Condition
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Treatment Plan Execution Condition STATEMENT: >>> The application shall prevent treatment plan execution if an interlock is active. The 'Beam-On' button will be disabled. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Restrict window switching during active emission
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Restrict window switching during active emission STATEMENT: >>> The application shall temporarily lock the treatment view interface during active radiation delivery. The left tab bar shall be disabled. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Perform Quality Checks
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Quality Assurance - Perform Quality Checks STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide the operator with an interface to test and record the quality of the beam. Before triggering the emission, the operator will set the Energy for which to perform the quality tests. The measured intensity will be recorded for each point. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-66.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Telemetry - No communication to GCB indication
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Telemetry - No communication to GCB indication STATEMENT: >>> The telemetry controls shall show a clear no-communication indication when no valid telemetry has been received from the GCB for 1.5 seconds. Stale telemetry values shall no longer be presented as current; affected values shall be shown as unavailable. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-82.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Patient Details
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Patient Details STATEMENT: >>> The treatment console shall display details about the treated patient and its treatment site. The patient details shall include the following: * Patient full name * MRN * Patient DOB * Field Name * Dose to be delivered (per fraction) * Collimator Type (Target Type) * Field/Shield Size * Devices * Setup Notes (Simulation notes) .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-85.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Patient Monitoring
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Patient Monitoring STATEMENT: >>> The treatment console shall display a live view of the treated patient for monitoring. The live monitoring will enable the user to stop the emission in case of a patient crisis or movement. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-86.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Emission audible indicator
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Emission audible indicator STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an audible indicator for the entire time the X-rays are produced. The indicator should be a plus of half a second on/off with 1 -2 KHz or similar. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Perform System Safety Checks
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Quality Assurance - Perform System Safety Checks STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide the operator with an interface to test and record system safety features: The operator will have the controls to prepare and activate the system for radiation. During the radiation, the user will check the: 1. X-ray light - A visual indicator that the X-ray is activated. 2. X-ray sound - An audible indication that the X-ray is activated 3. Door interlock - Open the door and check that the radiation stops. 4. E-stop - Press the physical stop button and check that the radiation stops. 5. Normal stop - Press the applicative stop and ensure the radiation is stopped. 6. Live video stream - Check that the live camera on the radiation head is working and the room is monitored. 7. Live audio stream - Check that the live audio on the device is working. For each test, the user will toggle the corresponding success/failure button. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-91.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - System Safety Checks Reports
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Quality Assurance - System Safety Checks Reports STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide the operator with an interface to display the history of test results which includes the following system safety features: X-Ray light, X-Ray sound, door interlock, estop, normal stop, live video stream, and live audio stream between the patient and operator. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-91-1.png .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-91-2.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Quality Checks Reports
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Quality Assurance - Quality Checks Reports STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide the operator with an interface displaying the history of quality test results. The results will include the current and the intensity for each operational point. The operator will be able to filter the results by the applicator type, energy level, and the date the test was performed. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-93.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Quality Checks Reports - Deviation
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Quality Assurance - Quality Checks Reports - Deviation STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide the operator with an interface displaying the history of quality test results. The results will include the current and the deviation from the referenced test for each test point (Diode) . <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Prevent Treatment if the Daily Safety checks is not completed
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Prevent Treatment if the Daily Safety checks is not completed STATEMENT: >>> The application shall prevent treatment if there is no record of safety checks performed on the day of the treatment or if safety checks are not completed. A safety check is not completed if the following features were not tested or failed: door interlock, e-stop, and normal stop. The application will display an error pop-up message to the operator stating that the treatment cannot be delivered if the safety checks are not completed. The pop-up message will be shown when the user presses the Prepare control. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Alert for uncompleted Daily Safety checks
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Alert for uncompleted Daily Safety checks STATEMENT: >>> The application shall display a warning pop-up message if the daily safety checks are uncompleted. The warning message will be displayed if and only if the following features are successfully tested: door interlock, e-stop, and normal stop, and the following features were not tested or failed: X-Ray light, X-Ray sound, live video stream, and live audio stream. The application will display a warning pop-up message to the operator asking the user to confirm the treatment even though the safety checks are uncompleted. The pop-up message will be shown when the user presses the Prepare control. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Perform System Safety Checks - Save Results
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Quality Assurance - Perform System Safety Checks - Save Results STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a control enabling the user to save the safety test results in the database. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-106.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Safety Interlocks
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment View - Safety Interlocks STATEMENT: >>> The dedicated interlock pop-up shall show system readiness at the top. System readiness shall be true if and only if the buffered master-fault input is clear, no system fault is active, every interlock required by the current firmware state is available and ready, and the applicator check is ready. The pop-up shall always show these operator-facing checks: * E-stops * Door closed * Keys * Applicator The Applicator check shall render exactly one row. It shall show ``No applicator`` when no applicator is attached; otherwise, ``Unknown applicator`` when the attached applicator is not registered in the database; otherwise, ``Incorrect applicator`` when the registered applicator does not match the treatment plan; otherwise, it shall show ``Applicator`` with the existing green thumbs-up indication. The three error labels are mutually exclusive and each makes system readiness false. E-stops and keys shall normally appear as one summary row each. When either group is not ready or is unavailable, the pop-up shall disclose the individual base and remote states below the summary row. All other interlocks shall be hidden while ready and shown only while in a bad state. Technical signals shall be presented with operator-facing group names: Robot arm, Cooling system, Vacuum system, Backup timers, High-voltage system, Control system, and Auxiliary safety circuit. The Auxiliary safety circuit group shall aggregate spare interlocks 1 and 2. The buffered master-fault input shall be shown as Master fault only when it is the sole bad interlock. Each active control-board fault shall appear as a separate attention item using its formatted fault message and a red thumbs-down indication. The pop-up shall use the application's gray default foreground for body text, with the existing accent foreground retained for section headings. On the External GUI only, a Clear Errors button matching the application's existing clear-errors control shall remain fixed at the bottom of the pop-up when the buffered master-fault input is bad or any control-board fault is active or latched. Activating the button shall send the clear-faults command. The button shall be hidden at all other times and shall not be present on the Internal GUI. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment - Prevent Treatment Initiation for Unapproved Failed QC Tests
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment - Prevent Treatment Initiation for Unapproved Failed QC Tests STATEMENT: >>> The application shall prevent treatment initiation within the Treatment View if any Quality Control (QC) test associated with the energy level and applicator type required by the treatment plan has failed and has not been manually approved by an authorized user. When the user attempts to initiate treatment (press the Prepare button), the application will: * Verify the energy level(s) used in the current treatment plan. * The system shall check the latest QC status for the plan's applicator and energy level. (i.e., the deviation from the reference values exceeds a predefined threshold). * If the corresponding QC test has failed, verify that a user has approved it. If it is not approved, an alert message will be displayed to the user, and the treatment operation will be blocked. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment - Prevent a Treatment When There Is No Approved Physics Data
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Treatment - Prevent a Treatment When There Is No Approved Physics Data STATEMENT: >>> The application shall prevent the user from starting clinical emission exposure (treatment) when no approved physics data is available in the system. When the user presses the prepare button, an error message will pop up with a message such as: 'Treatment cannot be started. Approved physics data is required.' <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Active Fault Information
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Treatment View - Active Fault Information STATEMENT: >>> The application shall display the currently latched control-board fault records. Each record shall show the fault category, formatted message, and the system state and runtime captured when the fault occurred. The application shall retrieve multi-entry fault snapshots by index, keep the displayed list synchronized with unsolicited fault and clear notifications, and provide a command to clear the latched records. Up to four simultaneously active records shall be displayed. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Disable Clinical Functions in Calibration Mode
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Disable Clinical Functions in Calibration Mode STATEMENT: >>> When the connected control board reports calibration firmware mode, the application shall disable the Treatment and Quality Assurance tabs and obscure their content with a message directing the user to service the device. Non-clinical service, log, and exit functions shall remain accessible. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

external_reqs.title: Treatment View - Layout
external_reqs.full: TYPE: Usability TITLE: Treatment View - Layout STATEMENT: >>> The user shall have an interface through which they can initiate radiation delivery according to a predefined treatment plan. The interface shall be accessible via a console located outside of the treatment room to ensure safety and compliance with radiation safety regulations. The layout should include: 1. Patient Identification 2. The plan's treatment fields. 3. The system telemetry: System status, Main timer (in sec), backup timers (T1 & T2) (in sec), Energy (in kV), and Current (in mA). 4. Activation buttons: 1. Prepare button - which will prepare the system for radiation (i.e., warm-up and loading). 2. Beam-On/Reset/Clear error - a multi-state control for triggering the emission, resetting timers, and clearing errors. 3. Stop button - Stops the emission. 5. Interlocks visualization. 6. System Signals 7. Live Camera to monitor the patient. 8. System readiness indicators .. image:: _images/RQ-H10TG-13.png <<< [[/SECTION]]

internal_tests.title: Load For Treatment - Resume Uncompleted Treatment - UI Test Case
internal_tests.full: TITLE: Load For Treatment - Resume Uncompleted Treatment - UI Test Case STATEMENT: >>> This test case verifies the functionality and operation of Load For Treatment. It validates that the component behaves according to specifications and system requirements. <<< STEPS: >>> 1. Click the Patients tab in the application navigation menu 2. Double-click on the patient with uncompleted treatment 3. Click the Treatments tab 4. Select the field/site with the uncompleted treatment (e.g., "Field 0 - BCC") 5. Verify that the treatment history shows at least one treatment marked as "Partial" or incomplete 6. Click the Load For Treatment button at the bottom right of the interface 7. Verify that an alert dialog appears with the title "Uncompleted Treatment Plan" 8. Verify that the alert message states: o "The latest treatment plan delivery was not completed. You can load the remaining treatment or a whole treatment." 9. Verify that the alert provides options (buttons) such as: o Load remaining treatment o Load complete treatment o Close/Cancel 10. Click Load remaining treatment (or equivalent option) 11. Verify that the system sends the remaining uncompleted plan to the external application 12. Verify that the external application is triggered/notified that a plan is pending for load 13. Verify that the external application recalculates the treatment time according to the latest treatment completion status 14. Alternatively, go back to step 6 and click Load complete treatment option 15. Verify that the system sends the complete treatment plan to the external application 16. Verify proper notification/confirmation of successful plan loading <<< EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: >>> 1. The Load For Treatment button is visible and accessible in the Treatments view 2. Clicking Load For Treatment triggers validation of the treatment completion status 3. An alert dialog appears when an uncompleted treatment plan is detected 4. The alert clearly informs the user that the latest treatment was not completed 5. The alert provides clear options to load either the remaining treatment or the whole treatment 6. Clicking "Load remaining treatment" sends only the uncompleted portions to the external app 7. Clicking "Load complete treatment" sends the entire treatment plan to the external app 8. The external application is properly triggered and receives the plan data 9. The external application recalculates treatment time based on the completion status 10. Remaining treatment time reflects only undelivered portions 11. Complete treatment time reflects the full prescribed plan 12. The user receives confirmation when the plan is successfully loaded 13. Clicking Close/Cancel dismisses the alert without loading the plan <<< [TEST_CASE]

Double-click on a patient to open the Simulation View 3. Click the Simulation tab 4. Select a field/simulation from the sites list (e.g., "Field 3 - BCC") 5. Locate the Simulation section with Lesion Size, Margin Size, and Field Size fields 6. Enter values in the Lesion Size [cm] fields: o First box (X dimension): Enter "5.1" o Second box (Y dimension): Enter "5.9" 7. Enter values in the Margin Size [cm] fields: o First box (X dimension): Enter "0.1" o Second box (Y dimension): Enter "0.1" 8. Verify that the Field Size [cm] automatically calculates using the formula: o Field Size X = Lesion Size X + (2 × Margin Size X) o Field Size Y = Lesion Size Y + (2 × Margin Size Y) o Expected X: 5.1 + (2 × 0.1) = 5.3 cm o Expected Y: 5.9 + (2 × 0.1) = 6.1 cm 9. Verify that the calculated Field Size displays: "5.3 x 6.1" (or as per actual calculation) 10. Modify the Lesion Size X to "1.0" and Lesion Size Y to "1.0" 11. Modify the Margin Size X to "0.5" and Margin Size Y to "0.5" 12. Verify that Field Size recalculates: o Expected X: 1.0 + (2 × 0.5) = 2.0 cm o Expected Y: 1.0 + (2 × 0.5) = 2.0 cm o Field Size should display: "2.0 x 2.0" 13. Test with different values - Lesion: "3.0 x 4.0", Margin: "1.0 x 0.5" 14. Verify Field Size calculates correctly: o Expected X: 3.0 + (2 × 1.0) = 5.0 cm o Expected Y: 4.0 + (2 × 0.5) = 5.0 cm 15. Verify that the Field Size fields are non-editable (read-only/calculated fields) 16. Click the Save button to save the simulation data 17. Navigate away and return to verify that Field Size persists correctly <<< EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: >>> • Lesion Size fields accept numeric decimal input (two fields for X and Y dimensions) • Margin Size fields accept numeric decimal input (two fields for X and Y dimensions) • Field Size automatically calculates when Lesion Size or Margin Size values are entered or modified • Field Size calculation uses the correct formula: Field Size = Lesion Size + (2 × Margin Size) • Field Size X calculation: Lesion Size X + (2 × Margin Size X) • Field Size Y calculation: Lesion Size Y + (2 × Margin Size Y) • Calculated Field Size displays with appropriate decimal precision • Field Size fields are non-editable (read-only/calculated) • Field Size updates immediately when Lesion Size or Margin Size changes • Saved Field Size values persist after navigation <<< [TEST_CASE]

internal_tests.title: Main View - System Status - UI Test
internal_tests.full: TITLE: Main View - System Status - UI Test STATEMENT: >>> This test case verifies system status and monitoring capabilities. It validates that system state information is accurately displayed and updated. <<< STEPS: >>> • The application is installed and launched successfully • User is logged in with appropriate privileges • The system is connected to the applicator hardware and actively receiving telemetry data 1. Log in to the application with valid credentials 2. Verify that a System Status panel is visible on the screen (typically on the left or right side) 3. Verify that the System Status panel displays the following information fields: o System status: Current status indicator o Energy [kV]: Energy level field o Timer [Sec]: Emission time field o Emission [mA]: Emission current field 4. Verify that the System status field displays the current state (e.g., "NoComm", "Ready", "Irradiating", "Error") 5. Verify that system error indicators are displayed when applicable (e.g., red error icon with "Applicator" message) 6. Verify that the Energy [kV] field displays the current or configured energy level 7. Verify that the Timer [Sec] field displays: 1. "0" or empty when system is idle 2. Countdown time when system is irradiating 8. Verify that the Emission [mA] field displays the current emission current value 9. Navigate to different tabs (Patients, Log, Physics, Settings) 10. Verify that the System Status panel remains visible on all screens/tabs 11. Verify that additional status indicators are present: o Radiation symbol/icon (visible when applicable) o System status message: "System not ready" or "Applicator" with appropriate icon o Information (i) and settings icons at the bottom 12. initiate a treatment simulation 13. Verify that during emission: o System status changes to "Irradiating" or equivalent o Timer counts down from the prescribed duration o Energy [kV] displays the delivery energy o Emission [mA] displays the actual emission current 14. Verify that status updates occur in real-time 15. Test with system errors (if possible): o Disconnect applicator o Verify error status is displayed o Verify appropriate error messages appear <<< EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: >>> • The System Status panel is visible and accessible at all times • The panel displays four key fields: System status, Energy [kV], Timer [Sec], and Emission [mA] • System status field accurately reflects the current system state (NoComm, Ready, Irradiating, Error, etc.) • System errors are clearly indicated with appropriate icons and messages • Energy level is displayed • Timer displays countdown during emission/irradiation • Emission current is displayed during active emission • The System Status panel persists across all application views and tabs • Status information updates in real-time during system operation • Visual indicators (radiation symbol, status icons) are present • Additional status messages ("System not ready", "Applicator") display when relevant • The panel provides clear and immediate feedback about system state • All status information is accurate and synchronized with actual system state <<< [TEST_CASE]

[These fields are mandatory because they determine the identification of the user] Mandatory fields are: - First Name - Last name - Date of birth - Sex - MRN <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Disable any application functionality during emission
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Disable any application functionality during emission STATEMENT: >>> The application shall prevent the user from any functionality when treatment (based on a plan) is being delivered. The application should be triggered for a plan being delivered and shall freeze the whole user interface. The plan will be set to a dedicated state (Loaded state), and the application shall be frozen when it is in that state. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Actual Dose Calculation
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Actual Dose Calculation STATEMENT: >>> A treatment plan shall be set with Energy, Duration, current, and Actual Dose. The Actual Dose should be auto-calculate from the duration using the following function: [Dose Rate cGy/min] \* Duration / 60 320 \* 18 / 60 = 96 cGy <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Add Patient's Prescription
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Add Patient's Prescription STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a user interface that enables users to add a record of the patient's prescription for the treatment plan. The prescription data entry shall include the following fields: 1. Energy - A dropdown control for the energy Enum 2. Dose Per Fx[cGy]: An editable field accepting a decimal number. 3. Fx per week - A dropdown control for 1-7 4. TDF: A dropdown control for the TDF Enum 5. Number of Fx: An editable field accepting an integer number. 6. Total Dose [cGy]: A non-editable field whose value is automatically calculated as the product of the Dose Per Fx and the [Dose Per Fx] \* [Number of Fx]. 7. Duration - The duration of the treatment 8. Add Button - Creates new prescription. When clicked, all fields shall be cleared, enabling the user to enter the data to be created and save them with the save button. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Alert for an Invalid Plan when Editing Energy in a Prescription
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Alert for an Invalid Plan when Editing Energy in a Prescription STATEMENT: >>> The application shall alert the user of an invalid plan if the Energy level of a prescription is edited. The duration of the treatment is calculated based on the Energy level of the prescription. If The Energy is edited, the calculation is not valid. The application should alert the user. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Alert for unsaved data
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Alert for unsaved data STATEMENT: >>> The user shall be alerted to unsaved data when exiting the plan view (e.g., pressing the scan or capture buttons, which opens a different view) without saving edited data. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-382.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Auto-Calculation Field Size
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Auto-Calculation Field Size STATEMENT: >>> When adding/editing a simulation, the application shall automatically calculate the Field Size based on the set Lesion size and Margin size. The calculation shall use the following method: Field Size X [cm] = Lesion Size X + 2 \* Margin Size X [cm] Field Size Y [cm] = Lesion Size Y + 2 \* Margin Size Y [cm] For example: Lesion Size = 1.0 x 1.0 Margin Size = 0.5 x 0.5 Field Size = 2.0 x 2.0 .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-740.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Auto-Calculation of Emission Duration
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Auto-Calculation of Emission Duration STATEMENT: >>> When adding a new prescription, the application shall automatically calculate the suggested emission Duration based on the prescribed dose and the used applicator's dose rate. The application shall calculate emission duration with a minimum resolution of 0.1 seconds. The calculation will use the following method: Duration [sec] = Prescribed Dose [cGy] / Dose Rate [cGy/min] \* 60 <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Auto-Calculation of Energy level and TDF of New Prescription
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Auto-Calculation of Energy level and TDF of New Prescription STATEMENT: >>> When adding a new prescription, the application shall automatically calculate the suggested Energy Level, Total Number of Fractions, Fraction per Week, and TDF values based on the input parameters of Pathology of the field, Lesion Size, and Cell Type set in the simulation and a predefined clinical protocol. The application shall enable the user to edit this suggestion. The used protocol: GentleCure Protocol _ Final April 2025.pdf <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Automatically Identify Connected Collimator
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Automatically Identify Connected Collimator STATEMENT: >>> The application shall be able to query the type of connected collimator and its supported energy and SSD. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Create Patient's Treatment Simulation
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Create Patient's Treatment Simulation STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a user interface that enables users to add a record of the patient's treatment simulation. The simulation data entries shall include the following fields: 1. Lesion Size[cm2] - Two edit boxes (numbers) for the two dimensions value. 2. Margin Size[cm2] - Number edit box. 3. Shield Size[cm] - Number edit box. 4. Lesion Depth[mm] - Number edit box 5. Position - A list selected from a dropdown menu. 6. Devices - A list selected from a dropdown menu. 7. Notes - Edit box <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Disable Treatment when the Patient's Plan is Inconsistent
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Disable Treatment when the Patient's Plan is Inconsistent STATEMENT: >>> The application shall not enable treatment delivery if the plan's applicator type differs from the actual applicator type. The application shall present an error message when the user tries to load the plan into the external application (i.e. presses the LoadForTreatemt). <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Edit Patient's Prescription
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Edit Patient's Prescription STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an interface to enable users to edit the patient's prescription. A prescription will not be editable if it is approved. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Emission Current Calculation
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Emission Current Calculation STATEMENT: >>> A treatment plan shall be set with Energy, Duration, Current, and Actual Dose. The Current should be auto calculated as the quotient of Power[W] divided by Energy Level[kV]: Emission Current[mA] = Power[W] / Voltage[kV] The device shall operate at a constant power of 50W. Here are the calculated values as a dependency on Energy Level: ========  ===========  ===================== Power[W]  Voltage[kV]  Emission Current[mA] ========  ===========  ===================== 50        50           1 50        70           0.71 50        100          0.5 ========  ===========  ===================== <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Layout
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Interface TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Layout STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a user interface to enable users to manage patients' clinical data. The view will include: 1. The patient demographic data section for the identification of the user 2. The Sites list 3. Simulation Details: - Lesion size[cm2] - Two edit boxes (numbers) for the two dimensions value - Lesion Depth[mm] - Number edit box. - Margin Size[cm2] - Two edit boxes (numbers) for the two dimensions value - Field Size [cm2] - A calculated field based on Lesion Size and Margin Size - Position - A list selected from a dropdown menu. - Device - A list selected from a dropdown menu. - Notes - Edit box 4. Prescription - The latest approved prescription (if exists) or the latest prescription exists. - Dose Per Fx[cGy] - Decimal edit box - Fx per week - Number Edit box. - Number of Fx - Number Edit box. - TDF - Dropdown control - Energy[kV] - Total Dose[cGy] - calculated field [Dose Per Fx] \* [Number of Fx] - Duration - Actual Dose 5. Treatment history - The UI Layout shall be implemented as a master-detail view within a multi-tab control. The master view shall present a list of the sites, and the details view shall present the clinical data (simulation, prescription, and plan details). .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-81.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Load For Treatment
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Load For Treatment STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users to Load the plan into the external application and enable the user to activate the patient's treatment. The user will have an action button that sends the plan to the external. Once this action is triggered, the plan shall be visible in external application. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Load For Treatment - Cancelation
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Load For Treatment - Cancelation STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have an interface that allows the user to cancel a plan loading and to enable the user to review the plan. This shall only be allowed if the plan delivery process has not started. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Patient's Plan Inconsistency Alert
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Patient's Plan Inconsistency Alert STATEMENT: >>> The application shall alert the user if there is an inconsistency between the planned applicator Type and the actual connected applicator. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Patient's Treatment Plan Audit Trial
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Patient's Treatment Plan Audit Trial STATEMENT: >>> The application shall log all actions done on the treatment plan, including creating, updating the simulation or prescription, and approving the plan. The audit should include who perform the action and when. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Plan's Treatment Parameters Validation in case of Applicator's Dose Rate Changes
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Plan's Treatment Parameters Validation in case of Applicator's Dose Rate Changes STATEMENT: >>> The application shall validate the treatment parameters fetched from the DB, including duration and dose, and alert the user if they are inconsistent with the calculated parameters. The duration and dose of a treatment are calculated based on the calibrated Dose Rate. The application should recalculate these parameters and compare them with those fetched from the DB. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Prevent editing of approved patient's prescription
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Prevent editing of approved patient's prescription STATEMENT: >>> The application should disallow users from editing a prescription of an approved plan. The edit box should be disabled. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Setting Energy Level
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Setting Energy Level STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide the user with an interface for setting the energy level of the patient's plan. A treatment plan shall be set with Energy, Duration, current, and Actual Dose. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - Verify Patient's Treatment Plan
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - Verify Patient's Treatment Plan STATEMENT: >>> The application shall allow users to approve/verify the treatment Plan. Approving a plan should trigger a pop-up asking the user for his user, password, and status to transit the plan. The status shall be one of the following: Name                 | UI Label PlanApproved         | Approved Rejected             | Rejected <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View - View Patient's Treatment Simulation
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View - View Patient's Treatment Simulation STATEMENT: >>> The application should allow the user to view the patient's treatment simulation. The Simulation view should include the following measures: 1. Lesion size[cm2] - Two edit boxes (numbers) for the two dimensions value 2. Lesion Depth[mm] - Number edit box. 3. Margin Size[cm2] - Two edit boxes (numbers) for the two dimensions value 4. Field Size [cm2] - A calculated field based on Lesion Size and Margin Size 5. Position - A list selected from a dropdown menu. 6. Device - A list selected from a dropdown menu. 7. Notes - Edit box <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan View- Load For Treatment - Disallow Plan Editing
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan View- Load For Treatment - Disallow Plan Editing STATEMENT: >>> The application shall disallow any change in the plan when the plan is sent to the external application. When the user triggers the Load for Treatment action, a modal pop-up will be displayed, disabling the user from editing the plan. The Plan status will be changed to Pending. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field)
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a user interface that enables users to add a record of the patient's site (field). The site data entry shall include the following fields: 1. Field Name - Edit box for the field name 2. Site Location - A Dropdown control for selecting the location. 3. Pathology - A Dropdown control for selecting the pathology 4. Subcell - A Dropdown control for selecting the Subcell. The display list is dependent on the selected pathology 5. Description - A Dropdown control for selecting pathology description 6. Referring provider. - The Referring doctor. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-388.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) - Pathology
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) - Pathology STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a dropdown control that enables users to select Pathology when creating a new site (field), which can be one of the following Enum: =================== ======== ======================== Name                Number   Description (UI Label) =================== ======== ======================== UNSPECIFIED         0 BCC                 1        BCC SCC                 2        SCC SCC-IS              3        SCC-IS Keloid              4        Keloid Basosquamous        5        Basosquamous =================== ======== ======================== <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) - Pathology Description
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) - Pathology Description STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a dropdown control that enables users to select the Pathology Description of the field created. Description when creating a new site (field), which can be one of the following Enum: ================================== ======== ================================= Name                               Number   Description (UI Label) ================================== ======== ================================= UNSPECIFIED                        0 Infundibulo_cytic                  1        Infundibulo-cytic Ulcerated_long_standing            2        Ulcerated long-standing Adenosquamous                      3        Adenosquamous Desmoplastic_Metaplastic           4        Desmoplastic/Metaplastic Recurrent_Lesion_post_surgery      5        Recurrent Lesion post-surgery Large_Lesion                       6        Large Lesion Deep_Lesion                        7        Deep Lesion Rapid_growth                       8        Rapid growth Extension_into_hair_follicle       9        Extension into hair follicle ================================== ======== ================================= <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) - Site Location
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) - Site Location STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a dropdown control that enables users to select the location of the field (site) when creating a new field, which can be one of the following Enum: =================== ======== =================== Name                Number   Description (UI) =================== ======== =================== UNSPECIFIED         0 Breast              1        Breast LeftEar             2        Ear (Left) RightEar            3        Ear (Right) Forehead            4        Forehead Temple              5        Temple Zygoma              6        Zygoma PreAuricular        7        Pre-Auricular Cheek               8        Cheek Chin                9        Chin Jaw                 10       Jaw Lip                 11       Lip Neck                12       Neck Nose                13       Nose Scalp               14       Scalp PostAuricular       15       Post Auricular Trunk               16       Trunk Chest               17       Chest Abdomen             18       Abdomen Back                19       Back LeftLowerLimb       20       Lower Limb (Left) RightLowerLimb      21       Lower Limb (Right) LeftUpperLimb       22       Upper Limb (Left) RightUpperLimb      23       Upper Limb (Right) RightUpperEyelid    24       Eyelid (Right Upper) RightLowerEyelid    25       Eyelid (Right Lower) LeftUpperEyelid     26       Eyelid (Left Upper) LeftLowerEyelid     27       Eyelid (Left Lower) =================== ======== =================== <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) - Subcell
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan view - Create Site (Field) - Subcell STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a dropdown control that enables users to select the subcell when creating a new site (field). The dropdown will show a list of possible subcells depending on the selected Pathology as follows: if there are no corresponding subtypes, the dropdown should be disabled. **Basal Cell Carcinoma** Subtypes: Aberrant, Adenoid, Atypical Basaloid Proliferation, Basosquamous (Metatypical), Adnexal Differentiation, Squamous Differentiation, Clear Ring, Cystic Cell Carcinoma, Fibroepithelioma of Pinkus, Infiltrative, Keratotic, Micro Nodular, Mixed Pattern, Morphoeic/Sclerosing/Fibrosing, Nodular (Classic Basal-Cell), Nodulocystic, Pigmented, Pleomorphic, Polypoid, Pore-like, Rodent Ulcer (Jacobi Ulcer), Superficial (Multicentric), Other **Squamous Cell Carcinoma** Subtypes: Acantholytic, Adenoid/Pseudoglandular, Atypical Squamous Proliferation, Basaloid, Clear-cell, Erythroplasia, Intraepidermal, Invasive, Keratoacanthoma, Large Cell Keratinizing, Large Cell Non-Keratinizing, Metaplasia, Mixed Pattern, Moderately Differentiated, Poorly differentiated, Papillary Carcinoma, Signet-ring cell, Small Cell Keratinizing, Superficial, Spindle Cell, Verrucous, Well-Differentiated, Superficially Invasive, Other **Basosquamous Cell Carcinoma** Subtypes: No Subtypes **Keloid** Subtypes: No Subtypes **Squamous Cell Carcinoma In-Situ** Subtypes: No Subtypes <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan view - Prevent Updating Approved Plan
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan view - Prevent Updating Approved Plan STATEMENT: >>> The application shall prevent users from editing an approved plan. The edit box should be disabled. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Plan view - view patient's prescription
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Plan view - view patient's prescription STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a user interface for the user to view the patient's prescription. The prescription displayed should be the one created for the selected simulation. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-24.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Treatment View - View Treatment Details
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Treatment View - View Treatment Details STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have an interface that enables the user to observe the patient's treatment delivered and their corresponding parameters. The treatment fields shall be a collapse-expand-like view and should be visible when the user presses the Details button of the selected treatment The treatment data should include the following information: - Actual duration - The actual duration of the delivery of emissions. - Actual Dose - The actual dose delivered in this field. - The current - the emission current. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Patients - Treatments view - Layout
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Patients - Treatments view - Layout STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have an interface enabling the user to observe the patient's treatment history for a certain site (field). The layout should include the patient data at the top of the view. The treatment history view shall be arranged as a master-details view. The master view shall include a list of sites. The details view should include: 1. The simulation data 2. The prescription data. 3. A table listing all the treatments delivered (fractions), including the following information: ===================== ====================================================================== Column Name           Description ===================== ====================================================================== FX                    The fraction number Date                  The date of the treatment. Lesion depth          The Lesion depth measured during that visit Energy                The energy delivered in kV Daily Dose            The delivered dose in cGy Cumulative Dose       Cumulative Dose in cGy Performed by          The user who performed this treatment Details               A link field shall open the details of the delivered treatment. ===================== ====================================================================== <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Alert for unsaved data
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Alert for unsaved data STATEMENT: >>> The user shall be alerted to unsaved data when navigating out of the view without saving the current edited tab. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Coil configuration
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Coil configuration STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to configure the target Coil parameters, which control the focus and deflection of the beam. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Heater current configuration.
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Heater current configuration. STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to configure the DAC value for the filament-preheat level, one for each applicator type, SSD, and kV. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Import configuration from CSV file
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Import configuration from CSV file STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to import physics parameters from a CSV file. The CSV file shall include configuration for coils, magnetometer, heater current, and applicator dose rate. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Import configuration from CSV file - Improper formatting in the CSV
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Import configuration from CSV file - Improper formatting in the CSV STATEMENT: >>> The user shall be alerted if the imported CSV has improper formatting and the import process field. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Layout
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Layout STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to configure the system physics data. The data shall be entered manually or as data imported from a CSV file. The interface layout shall include: 1. File upload control enables the user to load files from the filesystem. 2. A dropdown box for the applicator type. 3. A dropdown box for the applicator Energy Level. 4. A multi-panel view for each configuration: Magnetometer, Heater Current, Coils and Dose Rate of the selected applicator .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-120.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Magnetometer correction parameters
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Magnetometer correction parameters STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to configure the magnetometer correction parameters before installation for each energy level. The parameters shall be utilized to compensate for the offset effects of ambient magnetic fields on the electron beam steering. The parameters include the Correction Matrix and the Reference Fields for the back and front magnetometers. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Save Data
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Save Data STATEMENT: >>> The user shall be able to save physics data. The save button shall be disabled when no new data is to be saved or when there is an error in one of the inputs and enabled when a change is made. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Physics - Set Applicator Dose-Rate
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: Physics - Set Applicator Dose-Rate STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to configure the applicator's dose rate. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Quality Checks Reports
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Quality Assurance - Quality Checks Reports STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an interface (Role-based) for users to view the history of quality checks performed in the system. The quality checks report will be filtered by the type of applicator used for testing, its energy, SSD, and the date of the test. The report will include a table of intensity measured in the quality check process. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Quality Assurance - Quality Checks Reports - Deviation - UI
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Quality Assurance - Quality Checks Reports - Deviation - UI STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide the operator with an interface displaying the history of quality test results. The quality checks report will be filtered by the type of collimator it was tested with, its energy, SSD, and the date it was performed. The report will include a table the current and the deviation from the referenced test for each operational point. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Security - Data Encryption
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Cybersecurity TITLE: Security - Data Encryption STATEMENT: >>> The application will store the patient demographic data in encrypted format. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Service - System's Signals
Settings - Users Authorization Management - Create New Role
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Cybersecurity TITLE: Settings - Users Authorization Management - Create New Role STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide an authorized user the ability to add new roles to the system and assign specific permissions to these roles. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-619.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Settings - Users Authorization Management - Set/Unset Permissions
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Cybersecurity TITLE: Settings - Users Authorization Management - Set/Unset Permissions STATEMENT: >>> The application shall provide a super user the ability to manage the users' access permissions. The user will be able to set or unset the permissions to the predefined roles: RTT, Physicist, Service, and Administrator. **With the following permissions:** Patient's Clinical Data, Patient's Treatment, System Calibration, Quality Assurance, System Settings, User Management, and Services .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-618.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System Setting View - Applicator Management - Deactivate Applicator
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: System Setting View - Applicator Management - Deactivate Applicator STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to deactivate an applicator in case it is not used by the system (e.g. if it is out of order). The user shall select the deactivated applicator and, in the edit view, will deselect the Active parameters. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System Setting View - Applicator Management - Register New Applicator
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: System Setting View - Applicator Management - Register New Applicator STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to register new applicators. The user will register an applicator when it is connected to the head. The applicator serial will be identified automatically by the firmware, and the user will enter all other parameters: 1. Type - The applicator type (Target Type) will be displayed as a dropdown control listing the supported applicator types. 2. Energy - The applicator supported energy - A drop-down control that lists all support energy levels. 3. SSD - The collimator source to skin distance. [30,50] (optional) 4. Active - The collimator will be created active by default. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-127.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System Setting View - Applicators Management - Layout
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: System Setting View - Applicators Management - Layout STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to manage the system applicators. The user shall be able to view the currently registered applicators, add a new applicator definition, edit the data of an existing one, and deactivate an applicator if it is no longer in use. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-126.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System Setting View - Applicators Management - New Applicators Mandatory Fields
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: System Setting View - Applicators Management - New Applicators Mandatory Fields STATEMENT: >>> The New Applicators form should clearly distinguish which fields are mandatory and which are optional. Mandatory fields should be marked with an asterisk. Mandatory fields are: - Serial - Type - Energy - SSD .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-321.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System Setting View - Collimators Management - Register QC Collimator
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: System Setting View - Collimators Management - Register QC Collimator STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to register the QC dedicated collimator. The user will register the collimator when it is connected to the head. The collimator serial will be identified automatically by the firmware, and the user will enter all other parameters: 1. Type - The TARGET_TYPE_QC_COLLIMATOR type will be selected. 2. Energy - will be automatically set to 50. 3. SSD - will be automatically set to 50. 4. Active - The collimator will be created active by default. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System Setting View - Device Serial ID
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: System Setting View - Device Serial ID STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have an interface (pop-up) allowing the user to enter the device serial ID. The pop-up should be visible when the application is started, and no device ID is defined. The Device ID should be saved to the database. The cloud application will use it to identify the device from which the data is synced. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-249.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System Setting View - Endpoint configuration
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: System Setting View - Endpoint configuration STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows users (role-based) to configure the system endpoints to enable communication between system components. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-124.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System Setting View - User Managements
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Cybersecurity TITLE: System Setting View - User Managements STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface that allows admin users to manage the system users. The admin should be able to add, edit, or delete users. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-125.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: System logs' view - Layout
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: System logs' view - Layout STATEMENT: >>> The application should have a user interface allowing users to view system logs. The user interface should include: 1. An edit control for the term of the search. 2. A calendar control for selecting the time frame of the log. 3. A filter link button that will trigger the opening of the filter selection. 4. A search button to trigger the search. 5. A list view for the search result <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: User Authentication
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Cybersecurity TITLE: User Authentication STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a user interface allowing users to input credentials and be authenticated by the system. Once the user is logged in, the application should hold the authentication token and use it for all the API requests. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: User Login - Show/Hide Password
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Cybersecurity TITLE: User Login - Show/Hide Password STATEMENT: >>> The application shall have a control that allows the user to view or hide the typed password on the login page. Default view - The password is hidden. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-648-1.png When clicking on the icon - The password is shown. .. image:: _images/RQ-H10SG-648-2.png <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: User Profile Management
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Functional TITLE: User Profile Management STATEMENT: >>> The application should have a user interface to enable a super user to view, assign, and update user's roles. <<< [REQUIREMENT]

internal_reqs.title: Disable Patient Functions in Calibration Mode
internal_reqs.full: TYPE: Safety TITLE: Disable Patient Functions in Calibration Mode STATEMENT: >>> When the connected control board reports calibration firmware mode, the indoor application shall disable the Patients tab and obscure its content with a message directing the user to service the device. Non-patient service functions shall remain accessible. <<< [[/SECTION]]
